ruleUpdate: On HPE Synergy 12000 Frames (P51174-B21) populated solely with SY480 Gen12 compute nodes (P68217-B21), selecting Virtual Connect Fibre Channel upgrade licenses (R3P67A FIO LTU or R3P67AAE BTO E-LTU) is strictly forbidden and triggers CLIC Rules 81410905 and 81314323 (UNBUILDABLE CONFIGURATION: OVERRIDE REQUIRES FACTORY APPROVAL). SY480 Gen12 compute nodes route dedicated SAN traffic via Mezzanine 1 (P68131-B21 64Gb FC HBA) directly to Brocade 64Gb FC Switch Modules (P77653-B21) in Bays 1 & 4. Fibre Channel port expansion must be licensed via Brocade 8-port upgrade E-LTU (Q2E58AAE). Virtual Connect SE 100Gb F32 modules (867796-B21) in Bays 3 & 6 are dedicated to 25G/50G/100G Ethernet (via P64724-B21 adapter in Mezzanine 3), with no FCoE path on Gen12.
rawMessage: CLIC Rule 81410905: FC License SKU (R3P67A/R3P67AAE) must not be allowed for selection if Synergy 12000 Frame includes only Synergy 480 Gen12 compute nodes. Virtual Connect is pure Ethernet on Gen12; SAN connectivity is delivered by Brocade 64Gb FC switches (P77653-B21) and Q2E58AAE.
provenanceSources: HPE OCA CLIC Validation Error Rule 81410905

ruleUpdate: R3P67A is a Factory Integrated Option (FIO LTU) ending in 'A', which strictly requires sub-iteming under a factory CTO chassis base (P51174-B21), triggering CLIC Rules 81013168 and 81125904 ('must be ordered as a sub-item to the Base') if quoted standalone. If a customer procurement contract mandates this 32Gb FC license, it CANNOT be fulfilled using R3P67A. It must be ordered as R3P67AAE (BTO Electronic License / E-LTU) placed in a completely separate standalone software quote (new UCID) where no P51174-B21 chassis or Gen12 compute nodes exist, bypassing both Rule 81125904 and Rule 81410905.
rawMessage: R3P67A FIO fails with Rules 81013168 and 81125904 when ordered standalone, and fails with Rule 81410905 when attached to Gen12 frame. Solution: quote R3P67AAE (E-LTU) on a separate software UCID with no frame.
provenanceSources: HPE OCA CLIC Validation Error Rules 81013168 & 81125904

ruleUpdate: When a multi-frame Synergy deployment (e.g. 2 frames, 24 nodes) is partitioned into separate commercial orders (Option B): (1) Order 2 (Frame 2) is structured as a clean hardware clone with zero loose cables, zero loose transceivers, and zero unpack services; (2) Order 1 (Frame 1) hosts a dedicated Adhoc container carrying 100% of all loose physical connectivity for both frames (DAC cables: 487655-B21 10G, 845406-B21 100G; AOC cables: 845410-B21 100G; fiber: QK734A OM4; transceivers: 455883-B21 10G SFP+ SR, 845398-B21 25G SFP28 SR, 841716-B21 40G QSFP+ BiDi) totaling $96,236.00 list; (3) Embedded switch licenses (Q2E58AAE Brocade 8-port upgrade E-LTU) must NEVER be lumped into Adhoc—they must be split evenly inside the physical switch modules (4 in Frame 1, 4 in Frame 2) to preserve 1:1 hardware module licensing integrity; (4) Tech Care Basic support (HU4B2A3) must be preserved 1:1 on both frames ($46,156 each) to satisfy CLIC Rules 99916598/99916599.
rawMessage: Multi-order Synergy split pattern (Option B): Frame 2 is a clean hardware clone with 0 accessories; Frame 1 carries consolidated Adhoc container with all 7 cables/transceivers for both orders ($96,236 list). Brocade Q2E58AAE licenses are split 4-and-4 inside switch modules, and support is 1:1 ($46,156 per frame).

ruleUpdate: When a multi-frame Synergy deployment (e.g. 2 frames, 24 nodes) is partitioned into separate commercial quotes/orders: (1) Frame 1 carries 1x HA124A1#5ZM (First Frame Onsite Startup, $16,742 USD); (2) Frame 2 carries 1x HA124A1#5ZQ (Additional Frame Onsite Startup, $4,627 USD), saving $12,115 USD vs duplicating First Frame; (3) Order 2 remarks must cross-reference Order 1's UCID (e.g. 5157071497-02) to satisfy automated CLIC Rule 81039677 order acceptance; (4) If frames are deployed as independent standalone islands (separate sites or unlinked OneView domains), both frames require HA124A1#5ZM; (5) Remote Startup (HA124A1#V0F) and Onsite Startup (HA124A1#5ZM) are strictly mutually exclusive and must never be combined.
rawMessage: Synergy 2-frame split startup rule: Frame 1 carries First Frame Onsite (HA124A1#5ZM, $16,742), Frame 2 carries Additional Frame Onsite (HA124A1#5ZQ, $4,627), saving $12,115. Frame 2 must cross-reference Frame 1's UCID in order remarks. Independent unlinked frames require #5ZM on both.
